Name: Split Spouse Rooms (Free Love)
Author: Draevahn
Description:
[b]Description
[/b]Whenever you're playing around with the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love [/url]mod do you ever wish the spouse rooms aren't all just one long connected hallway?
Well with this mod, I've tried my best to customize the spouse room locations so that they are separated using that extra southern room you buy during the house upgrade!
This mod puts either the women's or the men's in the lower section of the house (depending on which one you download) in order not have such a long hallway!

[b]Updates
[/b]- Now compatible with Stardew version 1.6.15
- Updated to work with the updated versions of Free Love & Custom Spouse Rooms
- Default Krobus room location moved up to avoid colision with nook house addition
- Someone made an upgraded version with options and custom tiles to fix the broken ones, download that one instead if you prefer, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21525]Custom Spouse Room Locations - By KevinKidWell[/url]

[b]Notes
[/b]- This mod requires both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10029]Custom Spouse Rooms[/url] in order to function, as it is only a content pack for custom spouse rooms.

- If a spouse room is duplicated at original spouse room row, delete that spouse's name in the "config" file of the CustomSpouseRooms mod

- There are four versions of this mod, the main version is for when you have fully upgraded your house INCLUDING THE CELLAR, the other
version is for when you do not have the cellar, and then versions for if you want the girls in the lower rooms or the boys. If you upgrade your
house eventually just re-download the main version and replace the files. Unsure if the versions without the cellar work properly.

- This mod works best whenyou have all the bachelors and bachelorettes married already, since the rooms are in a specific order (You can change this if you want, by switching around the names of people in the content.json file, EXAMPLE: Select both "Haley" in the name and the template name and change to the character you want.) [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/111fZCRnVtJya5u6O4cGaRVigR5OGCKiI/view]Char Change Example
[/url][code]﻿{
﻿"name": "[b]Haley[/b]",
﻿"upgradeLevel":3,
﻿"startPos": {
﻿ ﻿"X": 49,
﻿ ﻿"Y": 33
﻿},
﻿"spousePosOffset": {
﻿"X" : 3,
﻿ ﻿"Y" : 3,
﻿},
﻿"shellType": "custom_spouse_room_open_right",
﻿// "templateName": "[b]Haley[/b]"
},﻿
[/code]
- Only works with the vanilla selection of spouses, if you marry a custom spouse their room will be added to the main hallway up top. (You
can customize this if you want to, but you'll have to alter the content.json file and add a line at the end like this:)
(Note the Dwarf example here puts his room next to Krobus', change the value of X in "startPos" if you'd like to change this position) [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1M7t2AdVS5JVRiSJcTQJky_lcjd0oeLQ0/view]Custom Addition Example
[/url][code]﻿},
"shellType": "custom_spouse_room_open_left"﻿
﻿// "templateName": "Krobus"
},
[b]{
﻿"name": "Dwarf",
﻿"upgradeLevel": 3,
﻿"startPos": {
﻿ ﻿"X": 8,
﻿ ﻿"Y": 7
﻿},
﻿"spousePosOffset": {
﻿ ﻿"X": 3,
﻿ ﻿"Y": 7
﻿},
﻿"shellType": "custom_spouse_room_closed_left",
﻿// "templateName": "Dwarf"
},[/b]
[/code]
[b]Credit
[/b]The code used in this mod is thanks to someone from reddit who made an example file for Krobus
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SMAPI/comments/x9ir1q/im_using_custom_spouse_rooms_and_im_not_sure_how/]The original page of the post[/url] & [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/herttz/]The original user[/url] so big thanks to them!
Because it was a bit difficult for me to figure this all out, I figured people who haven't customized their own files can do it with
this mod now!
